article.story: HOUSTON -- — Bryson Dawkins scored a career-high 41 points to lead Houston Christian to a 72-56 victory over Stephen F. Austin on Monday night. Dawkins made 16 of 22 shots with five 3-pointers and added 10 rebounds for the Huskies (12-17, 9-9 Southland Conference). D'Aundre Samuels scored 10 points. The Lumberjacks (14-15, 7-11) were led by Keon Thompson with 16 points and six rebounds. Kyle Hayman added 14 points. Chrishawn Christmas finished with 10 points and four steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
